Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.texteditor

Class EditorSettings

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.texteditor.EditorSettings
public final class EditorSettings extends Object
The Advanced Text Editor's user preferences: font, indent, view toggles, theme and the recent-files list. The class is a plain mutable value object with pure toMap() / fromMap(Map) serialisation — everything a test needs without touching the platform preference store — plus two thin wrappers, loadUser() and saveUser(), for the real desktop persistence under the java.util.prefs node "org/jdesktop/lg3d/apps/texteditor".

Every setter clamps into a safe range (a persisted garbage value can never produce a 4-pixel font or a negative tab width), and unknown keys in a persisted map are ignored so settings written by a newer build degrade gracefully.
